full_prompt_en: A square underwater photographic portrait shows a young woman among dense red and pink flowers while golden fish swim through the water beside her. Her face fills the left center, angled slightly down and toward the viewer. Pale eyes look outward, dark wet strands curve across her cheek, and softly parted lips remain visible beneath shifting light. A mass of flowers and small pale blossoms encircles her head and descends along her shoulder, mingling with darker trailing hair. At the lower left, a red-pink puffed sleeve catches broken silver highlights. On the right, several yellow and orange fish move at different depths, some sharp and others blurred by motion or distance. Deep blue-green water fills the open space behind them, dotted with bright bubbles and suspended specks. Across the top edge, the underside of the water surface forms a wavering reflective band, repeating fragments of red, white, and gold. Flowers near the foreground partly overlap the figure, while those farther behind her soften into the darker water. The composition is close and crowded on the left but opens toward the moving fish on the right. Natural-looking light filters from above through the ripples, making small high-contrast glints on petals, fabric, skin, and fish backs; lower areas fall into cool shadow. The photographic detail is softened by refraction and slight underwater haze rather than by painted outlines. No words or man-made signage appear. The overall image feels dreamlike and immersive, balancing warm floral and fish colors against dark aquatic depth and restless surface reflections.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形水下摄影肖像呈现一位年轻女子处在密集红粉花朵间，金色鱼从身旁水中游过。她的脸占据左侧中央，稍低头并朝观者。浅色眼睛向外看，深色湿发丝弯过面颊，微张的嘴唇在流动光线下仍可见。一团花和浅色小花围住头部，并沿肩部向下，与更深的飘散发丝交织。左下方红粉蓬袖接住断续银色亮点。右侧几条黄橙鱼处于不同水深，有些清晰，有些因运动或距离而模糊。深蓝绿水填满其后开阔空间，散着亮气泡与悬浮小点。上边缘，水面下侧形成摇晃反光带，重复红、白和金的碎片。近处花朵部分挡住人物，较远的花则软化进暗水里。构图左侧近而拥挤，向右侧游鱼处敞开。自然光从上方穿过波纹，在花瓣、布料、皮肤和鱼背上留下细小高反差闪光；下部进入冷影。摄影细节由折射和轻微水下雾气柔化，而非绘画轮廓。画中没有文字或人为标牌。整体图像如梦且有沉浸感，以暖花色和鱼色对照深水及躁动水面反射。
style_prompt_en: The image has an immersive underwater photographic finish shaped by refracted top light, suspended particles, and softly shifting focus. Deep blue-green negative space supports dense warm coral, rose, and amber accents. Small silver-white glints break across the upper edge and selected surfaces, while lower regions remain cool and dark. Edges vary between crisp nearby detail and blurred drifting color, conveying several depths in a tight frame. Overlapping organic clusters build a rich side mass that opens into freer space opposite it. Rippling reflections create irregular repeated fragments rather than steady bands. The overall effect is luminous, crowded, and dreamlike, with water acting as a visible optical medium.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有沉浸式水下摄影质感，由折射的顶部光、悬浮颗粒和轻轻变化的焦点塑造。深蓝绿负空间承托密集暖珊瑚、玫瑰与琥珀强调。细小银白亮点在上缘和部分表面破碎散开，下部则保持冷暗。边缘在近处清晰细节与飘散模糊色之间变化，使紧凑画幅中仍有多层水深。重叠有机簇团构成丰富的一侧体块，向对侧较自由的空间敞开。波动反射形成不规则重复碎片，而非稳定条带。整体效果明亮、密集且如梦，水本身成为可见的光学介质。
theme_en: An underwater portrait of a young woman among red flowers and golden fish
theme_zh: 年轻女子在红花和金色鱼群间的水下肖像
name: Underwater photography
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
